name: Bauernhof Maisfeld
beschreibung: The Bauernhof Maisfeld in Schwoich is run as a holiday home complex with several separate units. The holiday apartments are modernly furnished and suitable for families or couples. The property has a large garden with sunbathing lawns and seating areas. The village of Schwoich is located in the Tiroler Unterland near Kufstein. The surrounding area is ideal for hiking and cycling tours in the Alpenvorland. The accommodation offers an independent style of holiday in a rural setting with personal attention from the hosts.
